opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

On suggestion of the Attorney General of Illinois, the petition for writ of certiorari is granted; the judgment is vacated and the case is remanded for further proceedings.

Petitioner pro se. George F. Barrett, Attorney General of Illinois, and William C. Wines, Assistant Attorney General, for respondent.
